name: Tibial Stress Fracture
definition: Bone stress injury of the tibia resulting from repetitive loading exceeding remodeling capacity, ranging from stress reaction to cortical fracture.

typical: Pain may progress to walking/rest pain

investigations.MRI: MRI is preferred for early grading.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may show later cortical reaction.

amber: High-risk anterior tibial lesions require orthopedic/sports specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Bone stress injury of the tibia resulting from repetitive loading exceeding remodeling capacity, ranging from stress reaction to cortical fracture.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
